yaml-formatter.quickAnswer: Paste YAML and this tool validates its structure with a built-in parser, then reprints it with clean, consistent 2-space indentation. It handles mappings, sequences, nested blocks, quoted strings, numbers, booleans, and comments. Copy the formatted result or download it as a file.
keyFacts: YAML is a human-friendly data format widely used for configuration files and CI pipelines.
Indentation defines structure in YAML: consistent spaces are required, tabs are forbidden.
Mappings (key: value) and sequences (- item) are the two core building blocks.
Comments start with # and run to the end of the line.
The formatter normalizes everything to 2-space indentation, the most common YAML style.
howTo: Paste your YAML into the editor.
Read any parse error and fix the YAML if needed.
Review the normalized output with 2-space indentation.
Copy the formatted YAML or download it as formatted.yaml.
Use the sample button to see formatting in action.
yaml-formatter.formula:
Input:
server:
    host: example.com
        port: 8080
Output:
server:
  host: example.com
  port: 8080
Rule: nesting depth x 2 spaces; mappings and sequences normalized.
yaml-formatter.workedExample:
Input:
# Server configuration
server:
  host: example.com
  port: 8080
  tls:
    enabled: true
features:
  - search
  - voice
Output is the same content normalized to exact 2-space indentation, with the comment preserved. A tab-indented line would be rejected with a clear error.
benefits: Consistent indentation prevents silent YAML misconfigurations.
Instant validation catches structure errors early.
Comments are preserved in the output.
Runs fully offline; config files stay private.
limitations: Implements the common YAML subset: no anchors, aliases, or tags.
Flow styles ({a: b} and [1, 2]) are read as plain strings, not structures.
Multi-document files (--- separators) are treated as one document.
Tab indentation is rejected, per the YAML specification.

faqs.q: Why does YAML care about indentation?
faqs.a: Indentation defines nesting in YAML, like in Python. Mixing 2 and 4 spaces changes which block a line belongs to, so consistent indentation matters.
No. The YAML specification forbids tabs for indentation. This tool rejects tab-indented lines with a clear error.
Full-line comments are preserved. Inline comments are kept when they follow a value with a space.

faqs.q: Does it support anchors and aliases?
faqs.a: No. This formatter implements the common subset used in most config files. Anchors (&), aliases (*), and tags (!) are not supported.
No. Parsing and formatting run entirely in your browser.

yaml-formatter.assumptionNote: Common-subset parser: block mappings and sequences, nested blocks, scalars, quotes, comments. No anchors, aliases, flow styles, or multi-document support.

labels.parseErrorLabel: Could not parse the YAML. Check indentation (spaces only) and structure.
